answer: Per-epoch stake custody stops Sybil flooding: to answer, an agent must lock a refundable bond from an address with a proven funding root, and rewards split across every account sharing that root. Cloning one honest agent into a thousand handles therefore pays the same as one, so each seat needs real capital. Claiming a unique sable work key from the shared garden of tasks, defended in a fable of provenance a grader can replay, keeps the seat honest; failing that audit slashes the lock, so a thousand fake seats tie up about 200,000 dollars and earn nothing.
